prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a replacement AIB marketing image following the supplied floating bank-card reference. Input image 1 is the edit target; image 2 (Card.png) is the composition and floating-object style reference only, do not put the card or its text into the output. Output a wide landscape at approximately 2.4:1. Put the ENTIRE object group within the RIGHTMOST 35 percent, vertically centered, with ample top/bottom margin. The LEFT 65 percent must be uninterrupted clean backdrop for the app's text. Every object must FLOAT SUSPENDED IN MID-AIR, tilted in perspective like the reference card. The backdrop fills the whole image as a simple continuous studio color gradient. There is NO floor plane, horizon line, ground, surface, pedestal, plinth, podium, stage, base, tabletop, display stand, support, grounding shadow, floor reflection or vignette that suggests a floor. Photorealistic premium materials, restrained advertising product-shot quality. No text or logos or watermark. Change the globe scene into an airborne product composition: a compact translucent blue globe freely suspended, with a small metallic paper airplane flying just above it and a delicate arc orbiting it. Keep the blue color direction. Remove the entire floor and all floor reflections from the edit target. Globe must be wholly floating, not touching anything. Reduce golden glow; crisp elegant blue/silver look with modest warm accents.
